baseline.name: Conventional parsed-event call stack
baseline.approach: Parse each log and account elapsed time to the active call using a stack.
baseline.time: O(n+L), n functions and L total log characters
baseline.space: O(m) stack for m logs plus O(n) output

why: The archive uses the standard nested-call accounting invariant; custom character parsing avoids some parser abstraction but retains the same work order.
quantitative_comparison: Each log is parsed once and generates at most one stack push or pop. An equally linear parsed-event baseline has the same asymptotic counts; no parser constant-factor benefit is measured.
tradeoffs: Manual parsing trusts format, IDs and nesting and has unchecked allocations. A validated parser may offer better malformed-input handling despite similar complexity.
evidence_basis: Static comparison with the conventional stack algorithm; no parser benchmark.
